name: Bernd Lange-After Recital 27-Am 139
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on applying a generalised scheme of tariff preferences and repealing Regulation (EU) No 978/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council
part_text: (27 a) The unilateral trade preferences under this Regulation should also take into account the Union’s legitimate interests in the field of migration. Beneficiary countries are expected to cooperate effectively with the Union and its Member States on the return and readmission of their own nationals and certain third-country nationals who reside unlawfully in the Union. In cases of insufficient cooperation on readmission, temporary withdrawal of tariff preferences should be possible.
